1579201258472501249.a: Pet Peeve: Naming your product something impossible to find in Google. Trying to figure out where Bottles stores its Wine config. Google wants to sell wine these days. It is in no way helpful at finding info.

1579215750878724096.a: My favorite feature of Twitter is the ability to block advertisers. Houston Chronicle, New York Times, et al run ads to lure you to their website then hit you with a paywall. Block.

1579215752577835008.a: I have no understanding why I would want to subscribe to a local newspaper in a city in a state I have no interest in. This should tell you Twitter advertising is garbage. Why do they target me? I literally block almost every advertiser.
